--तं
1 Killing, striking.
--2
Multiplication.
--Comp.
--आश a. {1}
bereft of hope, hopeless, desponding.
{2} weak, powerless. {3} cruel,
merciless. {4} barren. {5} low, vile,
wretched, accursed, villainous.
--कंटक a.
freed from thorns or foes.
--चित्त a.
bewildered, confounded.
--त्विष् a.
dimmed in lustre;

.
--दैव
a. ill-fated, luckless, ill-starred.
--प्रभाव --वीर्य a. bereft of power
or vigour;

.
--बुद्धि a.
deprived of sense, senseless.
--भाग,
--भाग्य ill-fated, unfortunate.
--मूर्खः a dolt, blockhead.
--रथः a chariot
of which the horses and the
charioteer are slain.
--लक्षण a. devoid
of auspicious marks, unlucky.
--शेष
a. surviving.
--श्री, --संपद् a. reduced
to indigence, impoverished.
--साध्वस a. freed from fear.

हतक a. [हत इव नष्टप्रायत्वात् कन्]
Miserable, ill-bred, wretched, low,
vile; (mostly at the end of comp.),
न खलु विदितास्ते तत्र
निवसंतश्चाणक्यहतकेन
Mu. 2

; दूषिताः स्थ परिभूताः स्थ
रामहतकेन

.
--कः A low person,
coward.

हतिः f. [हन्-भावे-क्तिन्]
1 Killing,
destruction.
--2 Striking,
wounding.
--3 A blow, stroke.
--4 Loss,
failure.
--5 A defect.
--6
Multiplication.

1 A weapon.
--2 A disease or
sickness.

हत्या [हन्-भावे क्यप्] Killing,
slaying, slaughter, murder, particularly
criminal killing; as in भ्रूणहत्या,
गोहत्या &c.

हात्रं [हा-करणे त्रल्]
1 Wages, hire.
--2 Injuring, killing.
--3 Death.
--त्रः
A demon.
